title: MXC policy schema diff: vz containment backend (0.7.0-dev)
description: Additions to the 0.7.0-dev policy schema for the Apple Virtualization.framework (vz) backend. The containment enum gains the value "vz"; backend options live under experimental.vz, are optional, and default as annotated. Using containment "vz" requires the experimental flag. v1 validation rejects ui.guiAccess: true, proxy, and non-empty network.blockedHosts; deniedPaths entries equal to or inside a shared path are rejected. See docs/macos-support/vz-backend.md.

vz.description: Options for the vz backend. The whole object is optional; every field has a default.

guestImagePath.description: Absolute path overriding the bundled guest image. Default: the image shipped alongside mxc-exec-mac.

cpuCount.description: Number of virtual CPUs for the guest VM.

bootTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for the guest agent to become reachable over vsock before failing the spawn.
